Subject: Billing contact consolidation & invoice delivery preference

Hi Zoë —

Quick note as we prepare for go-live next month: we want to confirm who your AP team prefers as the canonical billing contact and the delivery channel for invoices. Two options we typically see work well:

1) Portal-first: invoices are pushed to your AP portal (preferred for AP automation), with an automated PDF copy emailed to a distribution address; or
2) Email-primary: Redwoods sends a PDF to a named billing contact and the portal remains optional.

For Helios, a couple questions to keep things simple on both sides:
- Is ap@helioshealth.com the correct mailbox for copies? If not, please share the preferred billing email and a short ACL (who should be CC'd).
- Do you need the invoice filename to include your PO number (we can template it as PO_<PO>#_INV_<invoice-number>.pdf)?
- Any specific remit-to or VAT line items that must appear verbatim on the PDF?

Ben’s on the thread to confirm our portal push/notification cadence; Marissa can pair on the filename/VAT formatting. If portal-first works, we'll configure a hybrid delivery so your AP system receives the structured payload and your team gets a PDF copy by email for human review.

Thanks — can you confirm by EOD tomorrow?

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the clear options. A few answers from the Helios side:
- Yes, please send email copies to ap@helioshealth.com. For visibility, cc me (zoe.myers@helioshealth.com) and our AP manager (sam.bates@helioshealth.com).
- We do require the vendor file name to include the PO when present — that helps our AP match. The PO_<PO>#_INV_<invoice-number>.pdf convention is fine.
- VAT lines: we need both the net and VAT rows visible and the VAT registration number on the header.

A couple of constraints to flag: our portal ingestion team prefers an SFTP or API push rather than manual download from a portal UI. If you offer an API/webhook push for invoice metadata + a PDF payload, that’d be ideal. If not, portal push + email copy is acceptable.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call with Ben and Marissa tomorrow to lock the fields.

Best,

Grace / Marissa —

Quick internal note to propose our standard implementation for customers who want both machine and human delivery:

- Primary: API/SFTP push of structured invoice payload (JSON or XML) into customer endpoint. We include invoice metadata (PO, invoice number, line items, VAT fields) in the push so AP systems can reconcile automatically.
- Secondary: Automated PDF copy emailed to the distribution list (ap@ + cc list). PDFs use the PO_<PO>#_INV_<invoice-number>.pdf convention and include visible VAT rows and VRN in header.

If customer's integration team accepts API/SFTP we can proceed with onboarding. If they only want portal push, we will set up portal push + same-email copy. Portal push cadence is immediate on invoice issuance, and we keep a 7-day retry window for delivery failures.

Action items for onboarding call:
- Marissa: confirm PDF sample (I'll attach a sample in my reply).
- Grace: schedule a 20-min call with Zoë + Sam + Helios integration lead.

Ben
Billing Ops
Redwood Inference
